records.label: COMSOL数据生成
records.disposition: Normal mesh, steady-state; a/b/c 1–12 mm; Sobol dimensions/temperatures; dynamic current bounds; positive-voltage normalization is computational convention, not permission to flip experimental sign.

records.label: TEGNet结构与分割训练
records.disposition: 6 inputs, 3×128 hidden SiLU, 2 outputs; 300/600/1200/1800/2400 cases; 80/10/10 parameter split, 80/20 assessment, five splits, whole-data final fit; no physical micro-actions or fabricated training run.

records.label: 单材料预测及跨材料泛化
records.disposition: MgAgSb, Bi0.4Sb1.6Te3, Mg3Bi1.4Sb0.6, Mg3Sb1.5Bi0.5, NbFeSb, GeTe, PbTe, CoSb3, AgCu(Te,S), Zintl, SnSe, SnS are model/property cases, not all synthesized here.

records.label: 域外与新材料模型
records.disposition: Above593 K extrapolation and ±10% illustrative properties/new-material workflow; no extra furnace experiment.

records.label: 分段几何计算优化
records.disposition: Cross-section 3.5×3.5 mm, total c 7/8/9/10 mm, Th573/Tc293 K; equal current and interface heat balance; these dimensions do not define experimental controls.

records.label: 恒热流边界计算
records.disposition: TEGNet constraint search versus COMSOL imposed flux; no new experimental constant-flux branch.

records.label: 电接触电阻率计算
records.disposition: Model rho_c sweeps remain separate from S1331 experimentally acquired R(x).

records.label: 热接触电阻率计算
records.disposition: No experimental thermal-contact-resistivity instrument/task is reported.

records.label: n–p面积/高度优化
records.disposition: Ap/An, H/(Ap+An), total area scans; physical module is only the separately bound two-pair case.

records.label: 1到32对数扩展
records.disposition: 1,2,4,8,16,32 pairs predictions; cannot multiply physical sample instances or hands-on credit.

records.label: 多段/新材料组合
records.disposition: Mg3Sb1.5Bi0.5–SnS, segmented n Mg3Sb1.5Bi0.5/Mg3Bi1.4Sb0.6 with p GeTe, three-segment, segmented-p topology and all p–n combinations are computational.

records.label: 文献与性能参照
records.locator: Main Fig.4j references; main/SI reference lists
records.disposition: External reported devices/property curves are reference records, never new specimens made by this paper or this task.
